notes.purpose: jaxfne/emitters.py (2167 lines) is the reduced Izhikevich E/PV/SST/VIP emitter scaffold: cell-type parameter tables, dense/sparse (EdgeList) recurrent simulation kernels (jax.lax.scan + segment_sum), homeostatic (r_i) and HDP (H_i master-state) plasticity variants, and thin OO facade classes (Emitter/IzhikevichEmitter/SynapseLayer). Module docstring (lines 1-9) states it is explicitly uncalibrated ('not a physical current in amperes'). It is imported by core.py, connectivity.py, _construct_core/_population/_connectivity.py, neuronal_tensor.py, hdp_network.py, _model.py, _model_simulate.py, _pipeline.py, tutorial_utils.py, and jaxfne/__init__.py (line 134) -- a load-bearing core module, not a leaf utility.

IZHIKEVICH_CELL_TYPE_DEFAULTS (line 27) is explicitly commented (lines 34-39) as the single source of truth for E/PV/SST/VIP/Inl/Ing/'I' parameters; 'I' is an explicit alias to VIP params, documented as intentionally replacing a since-removed silent fallback (dated 2026-07-13 in-code).
_get_cell_type_params (line 43) raises ValueError on unknown cell-type name -- explicitly documented as replacing a prior silent-fallback-to-VIP behavior for typo'd keys (e.g. 'pv' vs 'PV').

Last block (lines 2159-2167) re-exports HomeostaticEIParams/simulate_homeostatic_ei/etc. from the sibling module jaxfne/emitters_homeostatic_ei.py, with an explicit in-file comment explaining why: 'this file is already 2000+ lines and organized around the Izhikevich/EIG scaffold.'

izhikevich_params_from_labels has a build_dense_connectivity=False fast path (line 280, doc 290-298) added specifically because the default dense (N,N) W build allocated 40GB and OOM'd at N=100,000 in the real _construct.py caller path -- documented as a verified real failure, not theoretical.
contracts: izhikevich_params_from_labels(labels, *, layer_labels=None, dtype='float32', drive_overrides=None, source_scale=1.0, build_dense_connectivity=True) -> IzhikevichParams -- raises ValueError on empty labels or mismatched layer_labels length (lines 302-305); default build_dense_connectivity=True is a stated zero-behavior-change guarantee for existing callers (comment line 298).

simulate_eig_izhikevich / simulate_edge_recurrent_izhikevich: when drive_schedule=None the scan path is documented as 'preserved exactly' (lines 393-394, 573-574) -- a stated backward-compatibility invariant callers may rely on.
EdgeList.to_dict() (line 514) always sets physical_amplitude_calibrated: False -- a truth-gate field per the repo's calibration doctrine (matches AGENTS.md truth-gate language).

_get_cell_type_params: only names in IZHIKEVICH_CELL_TYPE_DEFAULTS are valid; anything else raises ValueError rather than falling back silently (lines 43-55) -- callers must pass exact-case cell-type strings.
landmines: No FRICTIONS_STACK.md row cites emitters.py specifically (checked skills/FRICTIONS_STACK.md, the only file by that name in the repo; grep for 'emitters.py' returned no match).

GLIFEmitter and LIFEmitter are advertised classes (public names in the module) that unconditionally raise NotImplementedError on construction (lines 2100-2117) -- any caller instantiating them fails immediately; documented behavior, not a silent gap, but worth flagging since the class names look usable at a glance.

The homeostatic k_gain docstring (lines 730-738) documents a real asymmetric-control limitation: k_gain is a one-sided damper that can suppress but not reliably raise firing above baseline, and k_gain > ~2.5 produces bursty bang-bang oscillation rather than smooth suppression -- a real caveat for tuning callers, not a code bug.
